literal: If life possesses food shared while fearing blame, the failing of lineage at any time is not.
translation: If a householder's life consists of sharing food with others while fearing blame, their lineage will never die out.
modern: பழிக்கு அஞ்சி, உணவைப் பிறரோடு பகிர்ந்து உண்ணும் தன்மையைக் கொண்டதாக இல்வாழ்க்கை இருக்குமானால், அவருடைய சந்ததி எப்போதும் அழியாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the core virtues of a householder: avoiding blame and sharing food with those in need. The word 'paḻi' refers to the moral dread of acquiring wealth through unjust means, while 'pāttu' emphasizes the duty of hospitality and charity. The poet promises that a household run on these two principles will never see its lineage die out. Thus, ethical living combined with active benevolence ensures the eternal continuity and prosperity of one's family.
